name: Maprisma Launcher
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Theme-aware app launcher, AI package advisor, and shortcut manager for Omarchy: launch apps in folders, cards, icons or a 3D cube, control windows, assign global Hyprland shortcuts on a live owner-coloured key map, and Ask AI (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Hermes, pi, or local LLMs via Ollama/llama.cpp) to find, install, update or hide apps. Includes an optional layer-shell dock. When the app is missing, a bar click opens a panel that installs the checked AppImage on request.
